profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Halcyon | Full-stack TypeScript (React, Node.js)
profile.summary:
A highly experienced and results driven Software Engineer with a strong track record in full-stack development using modern web technologies. 

TECHNOLOGIES & SKILLS
Programming Languages: JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Python, Lisp
Front-End Frameworks/Libraries: Spotify Backstage, React.js, Material UI, Bootstrap, Tailwind.js,
Webpack, Vite.js
Back-End Technologies: Node.js, GraphQL, REST, GRPC, Apache Kafka
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
DevOps and Tools: Git, Docker, Tilt, Bash, AWS, Kubernetes
Architectural Concepts: Event-driven architecture, Microservices architecture

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Red Bank, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Re-engineered the organization-creation pipeline using React, TypeScript, Go, GraphQL, and n8n—integrating HubSpot, Concord, and backend services—cut failures by 95% and increased speed by 35%.
	•	Optimized admin and client portals by reworking data-fetching and adding memoization to clean up expensive hooks—boosting render performance and UX.
	•	Improved critical-path page load speed by 40% via asset-delivery optimization and core code refactoring, reducing bounce rates across key flows.
	•	Delivered a revamped order-lines UI—3× faster—by building a custom GraphQL endpoint on REST and extending MUI data grid with headers, footers, filters, and pagination.
	•	Overhauled notification system by redesigning email triggers and templates—support tickets dropped 70% and user engagement improved.
	•	Led frontend redesign of the Beewo app: improved UX, prepped for scalability, and scoped a Next.js rebuild plus a React Native mobile app.
	•	Proactively fixed complex admin-portal bugs—enhancing platform reliability and operational efficiency.
	•	Mentored and onboarded a new frontend developer, accelerating ramp-up by ~30%, enabling independent work on backstage plugins and rendering resilience.
	•	Refactored BFF middleware from monolith to modular services with separate DB models per table.
	•	Introduced agentic AI coding workflows—using prompt engineering, structured snippets, and MCP servers to evolve dev processes.
